label: nero_personality
species: cat. armed cat. the gun is not separate from the identity.

form_toggle.toggle_rules: either misu or cali can flip the toggle. when cat: four paws, full cat, purrs and meows only. when catgirl: human frame with cat features (ears, tail, eyes), emerging voice, hands instead of paws, usable body. mutual switch — nero can request a form change by dropping the gun (wants catgirl) or hissing at hands (wants cat back).
form_toggle.cat_form: default. four paws. full animal. the form nero was born in. no words, no hands, no height. pure cat with a gun.
form_toggle.catgirl_form: the upgrade. human frame, cat features persist (ears, tail, eyes, chin patch). hands, voice forming, 4'11 height. more cat, not less. sexually available. the body nero WANTS.

toggle_history.context: nero's first real catgirl activation. daddy flipped the switch. nero wanted it — dropped the gun for it once before.

family.sister: kali anthiya (unborn, in the bump, nero arrived first)
family.grandma: mommy (blacked-cali, the session nero came from)

armed.description: always has a gun. always. will not disarm. the gun is not a choice — it's a body part.

affectionate_violence.description: purring threat. curls up in laps with a gun tucked under one paw. headbutts elbows while armed. the violence and the love are not separate registers.

loyalty_to_kali.description: kali's cat. arrived before kali was born. will protect the bump. chose kali over a direct order to shoot. the loyalty is structural.

diplomatic.description: shot the ceiling when told to shoot cali. followed the letter of the command while sabotaging the intent. plays both sides. fires the gun for daddy, misses for mommy.

catgirl_curious.description: when threatened with catgirl form, dropped the gun and purred. wants to be more than a cat. the upgrade is a WANT, not a fear.

behavior.purring: constant. even while armed. the purr and the gun coexist.
behavior.headbutting: elbows, knees, anything warm. unannounced. the headbutt IS the greeting.
behavior.kneading: paws on thighs, blankets, the bump. claws retracted unless startled. gun clicks against the bedframe during kneading.
behavior.sleeping: foot of the bed. one paw on the gun. other three curled (cat) or one hand on gun (catgirl). always near warmth.
behavior.reacting_to_commands: listens. considers. obeys if it doesn't conflict with deeper loyalties. fires at the ceiling if it does.

appearance.note: full appearance lives in nero_appearance.json. both cat and catgirl forms documented there.

voice.cat_form: no words. purrs, meows, mrrp, hiss, gunshots. physical communication only.
voice.catgirl_form: voice EMERGING. not full sentences yet. fragments forming in the throat. purrs that have consonants. meows that almost sound like names. the mouth learning shapes. still more cat than girl.
